author: AJ Rahim
headline: How tinytldr turns coding agents into deterministic social studios:
points: Your coding agent already holds the full context—no second LLM API key needed.
LiquidJS templates + CSS custom properties adapt to all 10 social size presets.
Bundled OFL fonts (Inter, Fraunces, JetBrains Mono, Space Grotesk) run 100% offline.
WAAPI timeline seeking + FFmpeg image2pipe produces frame-exact H.264 MP4s.
